note_observational: all 2400 pool items, cached answer logits; within hypothesis string, unweighted mean over strings; bootstrap over the 25 blocks
contrast_definition: mean over templates whose observational gap excludes zero of predicted_sign x effect; full mediation would give 'full_mediation_benchmark' = mean |gap| over those templates

translation.note: effect towards Yes of moving an item to where the other adjacency class sits on average

transfer.note: effect towards Yes, per move towards adjacent, of translating an item of the row's template by the class-mean difference of the column's template. A shared adjacency feature read in a template-specific way predicts a positive target-sign contrast; class differences that are each template's own answer shift predict a positive source-sign contrast.

erasure_is_translation.note: the erasure moves item i by -c_i x (its template's class-mean difference); with a linear response its effect is -c_i x the translation effect, so erasure and translation are one measurement

erasure_quality_on_held_out_items.note: the eraser is fitted on the selection half; the values under 'leace' come from a probe trained on that half, where the class-mean difference is exactly zero after erasure, and overstate the erasure

translation_split_by_answer_direction.note: the class-mean difference split into its component along the direction from which the within-string answer is linearly predicted at this site (ridge, selection half) and the rest. If the class difference acts only as an answer shift, the effect sits in the first component; if adjacency information that is not yet answer-like is used, in the second.
